title: Concern over High Prices of Motorcycle COEs in Recent Biddings
what_it_is: Concern over High Prices of Motorcycle COEs in Recent Biddings

sections.label: Category D COE bids
sections.summary: For the 8 August 2018 COE bidding session, 305 Category D motorcycle bids came from 25 bidders at different price points, suggesting no price collusion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For the COE bidding session ending on 8 August 2018, 305 bids were received for Category D for motorcycles in the last two minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These were submitted by 25 different bidders and the bid numbers were generally small.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Only one bidder submitted two block bids of 25 each.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The bids also came in at different price points, which does not suggest any price collusion.

sections.label: Category D COE prices falling
sections.summary: Category D COE prices fell from about $8,000 in February to $4,390 in September, and LTA will keep monitoring for irregular bidding or market manipulation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In fact, Category D COE prices have been falling steadily this year, from approximately $8,000 in February, to $4,390 in the latest September bidding cycle.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: While we have not observed any irregular bidding activity or market manipulation, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will continue to monitor the situation closely.

sections.label: Late bids in bidding cycles
sections.summary: Over the last two to three months, about 20% to 26% of bids were submitted in the last two minutes of most bidding cycles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In fact, if I look at the bidding patterns, just over the last two to three months, about 20% to 26% of the bids were actually submitted in the last two minutes of most of the bidding cycles.

sections.label: COE bidding system review
sections.summary: The speaker says the COE bidding system does not work this way, but it can be taken back to see what can be done.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I think the COE bidding system does not work this way.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But nonetheless, we can it take back and take a look and see what we can do about it.
